dn9:16.4: evampi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati. sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.
dn9:16.5: ayampi sikkhā”ti bhagavā avoca. “yato kho poṭṭhapāda, bhikkhu idha sakasaññī hoti, so tato amutra tato amutra anupubbena saññaggaṃ phusati. tassa saññagge ṭhitassa evaṃ hoti: ‘cetayamānassa me pāpiyo acetayamānassa me seyyo. ahañceva kho pana ceteyyaṃ, abhisaṅkhareyyaṃ, imā ca me saññā nirujjheyyuṃ, aññā ca oḷārikā saññā uppajjeyyuṃ. yannūnāhaṃ ‘na ceva ceteyyaṃ na cābhisaṅkhareyya’nti. so na ceva ceteti na cābhisaṅkharoti. tassa acetayato anabhisaṅkharoto tā ceva saññā nirujjhanti, aññā ca oḷārikā saññā na uppajjanti. so nirodhaṃ phusati. evaṃ kho poṭṭhapāda, anupubbābhisaññānirodhasampajānasamāpatti hoti. taṃ kimmaññasi poṭṭhapāda? api nu te ito pubbe evarūpā anupubbābhisaññānirodhasampajānasamāpatti sutapubbā?”ti. “no hetambhante. evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavato bhāsitaṃ ājānāmi:
dn9:17.1: yato kho poṭṭhapāda, bhikkhu idha sakasaññī hoti, so tato amutra tato amutra anupubbena saññaggaṃ phusati,
dn9:17.4: ahañceva kho pana ceteyyaṃ abhisaṅkhareyyaṃ, imā ca me saññā nirujjheyyuṃ, aññā ca oḷārikā saññā uppajjeyyuṃ.
dn9:17.5: yannūnāhaṃ na ceva ceteyyaṃ na ca abhisaṅkhareyya’nti.
dn9:17.6: so na ceva ceteti. na ca abhisaṅkharoti.
dn9:17.7: tassa acetayato anabhisaṅkharoto tā ceva saññā nirujjhanti. aññā ca oḷārikā saññā na uppajjanti.
dn9:19.1: “ekaññeva nu kho bhante, bhagavā saññaggaṃ paññapeti udāhu puthū’pi saññagge paññapetī?”ti.
dn9:19.2: “ekampi kho ahaṃ poṭṭhapāda, saññaggaṃ paññapemi. puthū’pi saññagge paññapemī”ti.
dn9:19.3: “yathākathaṃ pana bhante, bhagavā ekampi saññaggaṃ paññapeti? puthūpi saññagge paññapetī?”ti.
dn9:19.4: “yathā yathā kho poṭṭhapāda, nirodhaṃ phusati, tathā tathā’haṃ saññaggaṃ paññapemi.
dn9:19.5: evaṃ kho ahaṃ poṭṭhapāda, ekampi saññaggaṃ paññapemi, puthū’pi saññagge paññapemī”ti.
dn9:20.1: “saññā nu kho bhante, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ.? udāhu ñāṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā saññā? udāhu saññā ca ñāṇañca apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjantī?”ti.
dn9:20.2: “saññā kho poṭṭhapāda, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati pacchā ñāṇaṃ. saññuppādā ca pana ñāṇuppādo hoti.
dn9:20.5: iminā kho etaṃ poṭṭhapāda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ,
dn9:20.6: yathā saññā paṭhamaṃ uppajjati pacchā ñāṇaṃ, saññuppādā ca pana ñāṇuppādo hotī”ti.
dn9:21.1: “saññā nu kho bhante, purisassa attā? udāhu aññā saññā añño attā?”ti.
dn9:21.3: “oḷārikaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, attānaṃ paccemi rūpiṃ cātummahābhūtikaṃ kabaḷīkārāhārabhakkhanti”
dn9:21.4: “oḷāriko ca hi te poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa rūpī cātummahābhūtiko kabaḷīkārāhārabhakkho. evaṃ santaṃ kho te poṭṭhapāda aññā’va saññā bhavissati, añño attā.
dn9:21.5: tadamināpetaṃ poṭṭhapāda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ, yathā aññā’va saññā bhavissati, añño attā.
dn9:21.6: tiṭṭhatevasāyaṃ poṭṭhapāda, oḷāriko attā rūpī cātummahābhūtiko kabaḷīkārāhārabhakkho. atha imassa purisassa aññā’ca saññā uppajjanti aññā’ca saññā nirujjhanti.
dn9:21.7: iminā kho etaṃ poṭṭhapāda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ, yathā aññā’va saññā bhavissati, añño attā”ti.
dn9:22.1: “manomayaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante attānaṃ paccemi sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyanti”.
dn9:22.2: “manomayo ca hi te poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa sabbaṅgapaccaṅgī ahīnindriyo, evaṃ santampi kho te poṭṭhapāda, aññā’va saññā bhavissati, añño attā.

dn9:22.4: “tiṭṭhatevāyaṃ poṭṭhapāda, manomayo attā sabbaṅgapaccaṅgī ahīnindriyo. atha imassa purisassa aññā’ca saññā uppajjanti, aññā ca saññā nirujjhanti.
dn9:22.5: imināpi kho etaṃ poṭṭhapāda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ, yathā aññā’va saññā bhavissati, añño attā’ti”.
dn9:23.1: “arūpiṃ kho ahaṃ bhante attānaṃ paccemi saññāmayanti.”
dn9:23.2: “arūpī ca te poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa saññāmayo, evaṃ santampi kho te poṭṭhapāda, aññā’va saññā bhavissati. añño attā.

dn9:24.4: saññā purisassa attā’ti vā, aññā saññā, añño attā’ti vā”ti.
dn9:25.1: “sace taṃ bhante, mayā dujjānaṃ aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrāyogena aññatrācariyakena
dn9:25.2: ‘saññā purisassa attā’ti vā, ‘aññā saññā, añño attā’ti vā.
dn9:25.3: ‘kiṃ pana bhante sassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?”

dn9:27.1: “kiṃ pana bhante, antavā loko. idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?” “etampi kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ ‘antavā loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?” “kiṃ pana bhante,
dn9:27.2: anantavā loko. idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?” “etampi kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ ‘anantavā loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?”. “kiṃ pana bhante,
dn9:27.3: taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ. idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?” “etampi kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti”. “kiṃ pana bhante,

dn9:27.5: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā. idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?” “etampi kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ ‘hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā. idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti”. “kiṃ pana bhante,

dn9:27.10: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā. idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti”.
dn9:28.2: na hetaṃ poṭṭhapāda, atthasaṃhitaṃ na dhammasaṃhitaṃ nādibrahmacariyakaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati,
dn9:29.2: “idaṃ dukkhanti’ kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā byākataṃ. ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā byākataṃ. ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā byākataṃ. ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā’ti kho poṭṭhapāda, mayā byākatanti”.
dn9:30.2: “etaṃ hi kho poṭṭhapāda, atthasaṃhitaṃ etaṃ dhammasaṃhitaṃ etaṃ ādibrahmacariyakaṃ. etaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
dn9:31.1: atha kho te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato poṭṭhapādaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāsattitodakena sañjambhariṃ akaṃsu:
dn9:31.2: “evameva panāyaṃ bhavaṃ poṭṭhapādo yaññadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati taṃ tadevassa abbhanumodati.
dn9:31.4: na kho pana mayaṃ kiñci samaṇassa gotamassa ekaṃsikaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāma:
dn9:31.5: sassato loko’ti vā asassato loko’ti vā, antavā loko’ti vā, anantavā loko’ti vā, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā”ti.

dn9:31.9: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā.

dn9:31.11: bhūtaṃ kho pana tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññāpentassa dhammaṭṭhitaṃ dhammaniyāmakaṃ, kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso viññū samaṇassa gotamassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodeyyā?”ti
dn9:32.1: atha kho dvīhatīhassa accayena citto ca hatthisāriputto poṭṭhapādo ca paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā citto hatthisāriputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.

dn9:32.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho poṭṭhapādo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn9:32.4: tadā maṃ bhante te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato samantato vācāsattitodakena sañjambhariṃ akaṃsu:

dn9:32.7: na kho pana mayaṃ kiñci samaṇassa gotamassa ekaṃsikaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāma:

dn9:32.12: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā.

dn9:33.1: sabbeva kho ete poṭṭhapāda, paribbājakā andhā acakkhukā.
dn9:33.3: ekaṃsikā’pi hi kho poṭṭhapāda mayā dhammā desitā paññattā.
dn9:33.4: anekaṃsikā’pi hi kho poṭṭhapāda mayā dhammā desitā paññattā.
dn9:33.5: katame ca te poṭṭhapāda, mayā anekaṃsikā dhammā desitā paññattā?
dn9:33.6: ‘sassato loko’ti vā kho poṭṭhapāda mayā anekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto
dn9:33.7: ‘asassato loko’ti vā kho poṭṭhapāda mayā anekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto.
dn9:33.13: ‘na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā kho poṭṭhapāda …pe…
dn9:33.14: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā kho poṭṭhapāda …pe…
dn9:33.15: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā kho poṭṭhapāda mayā anekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto.
dn9:33.16: kasmā ca te poṭṭhapāda, mayā anekaṃsikā dhammā desitā paññattā?
dn9:33.17: na hete poṭṭhapāda atthasaṃhitā na dhammasaṃhitā na ādibrahmacariyakā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn9:33.18: tasmā te mayā anekaṃsikā dhammā desitā paññattā.
dn9:33.20: katame ca te poṭṭhapāda, mayā ekaṃsikā dhammā desitā paññattā?
dn9:33.21: ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti kho poṭṭhapāda mayā ekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto.
dn9:33.22: ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti kho poṭṭhapāda mayā ekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto.
dn9:33.23: ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti kho poṭṭhapāda mayā ekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto.
dn9:33.24: ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti kho poṭṭhapāda mayā ekaṃsiko dhammo desito paññatto.
dn9:33.25: kasmā ca te poṭṭhapāda, mayā ekaṃsikā dhammā desitā paññattā?
dn9:33.26: ete poṭṭhapāda atthasaṃhitā, ete dhammasaṃhitā, ete ādibrahmacariyakā, ete nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn9:33.27: tasmā te mayā ekaṃsikā dhammā desitā paññattā.
dn9:34.1: santi kho poṭṭhapāda, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
dn9:34.6: te ce me evaṃ puṭṭhā ‘āmā’ti paṭijānanti,
dn9:34.8: ‘api pana tumhe āyasmanto ekantasukhaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharathā’ti.
dn9:34.11: ‘api ca pana tumhe āyasmanto ekaṃ vā rattiṃ ekaṃ vā divasaṃ upaḍḍhaṃ vā rattiṃ upaḍḍhaṃ vā divasaṃ ekantasukhiṃ attānaṃ sampajānāthā?’ti.
dn9:34.15: ‘ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā ekantasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāyā?’ti.
dn9:34.18: ‘api pana tumhe āyasmanto yā tā devatā ekantasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā, tāsaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ saddaṃ suṇātha:
dn9:34.19: ‘supaṭipannāttha mārisā, ujupaṭipannāttha mārisā, ekantasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāya.
dn9:34.20: mayampi hi mārisā evampaṭipannā ekantasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti?

dn9:52.7: sappimaṇḍo hoti, neva tasmiṃ samaye khīranti saṅkhaṃ gacchati. na dadhīti saṅkhaṃ gacchati. na navanītanti saṅkhaṃ gacchati. na sappīti saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

dn9:53.2: yasmiṃ citta samaye manomayo attapaṭilābho hoti …pe…
dn9:53.3: yasmiṃ citta samaye arūpo attapaṭilābho hoti, neva tasmiṃ samaye oḷāriko attapaṭilābho’ti saṅkhaṃ gacchati. na manomayo attapaṭilābho’ti saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
dn9:53.5: imā kho citta lokasamaññā lokaniruttiyo lokavohārā lokapaññattiyo yāhi tathāgato voharati aparāmasanti.
dn9:54.1: evaṃ vutte poṭṭhapādo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn9:54.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti, evameva bhante bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn9:54.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn9:54.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
dn9:55.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti. evameva bhante bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.

dn9:55.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
dn9:56.1: alattha kho citto hatthisāriputto bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
dn9:56.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā citto hatthisāriputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
dn9:56.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsi.
dn9:56.4: aññataro ca kho panāyasmā citto hatthisāriputto arahataṃ ahosīti.
